page.layout: One page of text, with notes in the right margin. The left edge shows part of the adjacent page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: JAPONICA.
Periodus I.
Explicatio.
main_text.p: Insula Japoniæ sive Nippan (ver-naculo idiomate Hippon) divisa LIII regna. Unum olim Mona-cham habuit, quem Dairum appel-labant.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
Explicatio.
main_text.p: Seculò post Christum Natum de-cimô Sextô, magnis bellicis motibus & cruentis seditionibus sedatis. Cir-ca initium decimi septimi, vel paulò postea, Taicosamma totius Japo-ponie[?]

page.notes: The right-margin note "3. Japonica." stands beside the heading JAPONICA.; it is placed inside the following "Canon." paragraph because a note must sit in a paragraph. The running head "Cœreanum" is hard to read and may be "Coreanum". "Taicosamma" is in italics and the long s is uncertain. The catchword "ponie" is partly faint and was taken as the start of the next page's word "Japonie". Faint show-through from the reverse side in the right margin was ignored.
